sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
I'm Roman Mars.
In downtown Providence, Rhode Island, there's a large plot of land that sits on the bank of the Woonosquatucket River.
sentences.zh: 在罗德岛州普罗维登斯市中心，伍诺斯夸塔基特河岸边有一大片土地。

sentences.en: In 1838, it was the home of the Rhode Island State Prison, which was notorious for its horrid smell, dreary outward appearance, and reputation for solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 1838年，这里曾是罗德岛州立监狱的所在地，该监狱因其恶臭、阴郁的外观以及单独监禁的恶名而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: Later, the land housed the continuing education campus for the University of Rhode Island.
sentences.zh: 后来，这片土地成为了罗德岛大学的继续教育校区。

sentences.en: And after that, a dirt parking lot called Ray's Park and Lock.
sentences.zh: 再后来，变成了一个叫“雷氏停车锁车场”的土质停车场。

sentences.en: Then, in 1999, in a grand effort to revitalize the city, and with much fanfare, the Providence Place Mall was opened.
sentences.zh: 接着，在1999年，为了振兴城市，普罗维登斯广场购物中心在万众瞩目中隆重开业。

sentences.en: That's Vanessa Lowe, producer of the podcast, Nocturne.
sentences.zh: 那是凡妮莎·洛，播客《夜曲》的制作人。

sentences.en: The mall, costing $500 million, was what was known as a super regional, a one-stop shopping destination,
sentences.zh: 这座耗资5亿美元的购物中心被称为“超级区域中心”，是一个一站式的购物目的地，

sentences.en: housing everything consumers could possibly want or need in a totally enclosed space.
sentences.zh: 在一个完全封闭的空间里容纳了消费者可能想要或需要的一切。

sentences.en: Partially funded by taxpayer money, it spanned 13 acres, offered 1.4 million square feet of retail space, and dominated the riverfront.
sentences.zh: 它部分由纳税人的钱资助，占地13英亩，提供140万平方英尺的零售空间，并占据了河滨的主导地位。

sentences.en: It was the largest construction project in Providence's history.
sentences.zh: 这是普罗维登斯历史上最大的建设项目。

sentences.en: This one building.
And we sort of stood in awe watching it get built.
sentences.zh: 我们当时看着它拔地而起，感到有些敬畏。

sentences.en: Michael Townsend is an artist who lived nearby when the mall was still under construction in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·汤森是一位艺术家，90年代购物中心还在建设时，他就住在附近。

sentences.en: His daily running route took him past the construction site, and Michael says that as he watched it go up, he had an open mind about the project.
sentences.zh: 他每天跑步都会经过工地，迈克尔说，当他看着它建起来时，他对这个项目持开放态度。

sentences.en: He was cautiously optimistic that it would be a welcome addition to the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他谨慎地乐观认为，这将是社区的一个受欢迎的补充。

sentences.en: But yeah, that didn't last long.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，那种感觉没持续多久。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's funny.
The revulsion to a building like that doesn't really kick in until the skin gets put on.
sentences.zh: 对这类建筑的厌恶感，直到它穿上“外衣”才会真正显现出来。

sentences.en: When something is in its erector set mode, when you're just seeing the skeleton, you're like, oh, that's a pretty cool skeleton.
sentences.zh: 当它还处于“拼装玩具”阶段，当你只看到骨架时，你会觉得，哦，那骨架还挺酷的。

sentences.en: But as soon as the flesh is there, you're like, ooh, not pretty.
sentences.zh: 但一旦有了血肉，你就会觉得，噢，真难看。

sentences.en: Providence Place was going to be a big, boxy stack of shops without much in the way of architectural niceties.
sentences.zh: 普罗维登斯广场注定是一个巨大、方正的商店堆砌体，几乎没什么建筑美感可言。

sentences.en: And on his runs, Michael watched as that big box was slowly filled with the things that make a mall a mall.
sentences.zh: 在跑步时，迈克尔看着那个大盒子慢慢被那些让购物中心成为购物中心的东西填满。

sentences.en: As it's being built, I start to sort of do mental maps of spaces.
sentences.zh: 在它建造的过程中，我开始在脑海中对这些空间进行规划。

sentences.en: You know, that's going to be a store, that's going to be a storage space, that's going to be parking.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是商店，那是储藏室，那是停车场。

sentences.en: But amidst all the construction, there was one part of the building that kept catching Michael's eye.
sentences.zh: 但在所有的施工中，建筑里有一个部分一直吸引着迈克尔的注意。

sentences.en: A weird space in the guts of the architecture that didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 那是建筑内部一个奇怪的空间，让人摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: I thought that was really odd.
It didn't seem to meet the profile of either a storage space or a parking space or a store space.
sentences.zh: 它看起来既不像储藏室，也不像停车场，更不像商店。

sentences.en: Michael wasn't sure what the space was for.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔不确定那个空间是干什么用的。

sentences.en: It seemed to exist only by virtue of the walls intended for the more legitimate spaces around it.
sentences.zh: 它似乎仅仅是因为周围那些更“正经”的空间所留下的墙壁而存在的。

sentences.en: But the result was this room.
sentences.zh: 但结果就形成了这个房间。

sentences.en: It was an accidental room.
A remainder left over by the long division of the mall's architecture.
sentences.zh: 是购物中心建筑结构在长除法之后剩下的余数。

sentences.en: I had never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过这样的东西。

sentences.en: And every time I ran by it, it was something that I would think about.
sentences.zh: 每次我跑过它，我都会想起它。

sentences.en: Michael eventually put the strange room out of his mind.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔最终把这个奇怪的房间抛在了脑后。

sentences.en: He probably would have forgotten about it entirely.
sentences.zh: 他本可能会彻底忘记它。

sentences.en: Except that four years later, a second group of developers, encouraged by the success of Providence Place, set their sights even closer to Michael.
sentences.zh: 但四年后，受普罗维登斯广场成功的鼓舞，第二批开发商将目光投向了离迈克尔更近的地方。

sentences.en: This time, they wanted to build right on top of the historic mill district, where Michael and a dozen or so other artists lived and worked,
sentences.zh: 这一次，他们想直接在历史悠久的磨坊区上盖楼，迈克尔和其他十几位艺术家就在那里生活和工作，

sentences.en: in an old industrial building they called Fort Thunder.
sentences.zh: 在一栋他们称之为“雷霆堡”的老工业建筑里。

sentences.en: The developers had used a computer algorithm to figure out where to place a new supermarket, so that it wouldn't compete with other supermarkets in the area.
sentences.zh: 开发商使用计算机算法来确定新超市的位置，以确保它不会与该地区的其他超市竞争。

sentences.en: And I got to see this computer printout, and it's sort of like a nuclear explosion map.
sentences.zh: 我看到了那份电脑打印件，看起来就像一张核爆炸地图。

sentences.en: You could sort of see the radius from each supermarket and their theoretical reach.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到每个超市的辐射半径及其理论覆盖范围。

sentences.en: And in the blank spot that was our neighborhood, they put an X directly on the building we were living.
sentences.zh: 而在我们社区那片空白处，他们直接在我们居住的建筑上打了一个叉。

sentences.en: And that was just the start.
The developers wanted to tear down all of the old mill buildings,
sentences.zh: 开发商想拆掉所有的老磨坊建筑，

sentences.en: and replaced them with yet more retail, with little to no pedestrian access.
sentences.zh: 并用更多的零售店取而代之，且几乎没有行人通道。

sentences.en: And it appears that the only mantra they have is,
sentences.zh: 而且看起来他们唯一的信条就是，

sentences.en: if you see a space that's underdeveloped, you have a God-given responsibility to develop it.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到一个未充分利用的空间，你就有上帝赋予的责任去开发它。

sentences.en: And it was basically like having a complete stranger be like,
sentences.zh: 这基本上就像是一个完全陌生的人对你说，

sentences.en: we've been thinking about it, and we think we want to knock your house down.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑过了，我们想把你家拆了。

sentences.en: And make it a parking lot if it's cool with you.
sentences.zh: 如果你没意见的话，把它变成停车场。

sentences.en: Now, normally this would be the part of the story where we tell you that Michael and the other residents of Fort Thunder
sentences.zh: 通常，故事讲到这里，我们就会告诉你，迈克尔和雷霆堡的其他居民

sentences.en: banded together to save their home in the face of the relentless march of Capitol.
sentences.zh: 团结起来，面对资本无情的推进，保卫了他们的家园。

sentences.en: But no, it's not that kind of story.
sentences.zh: 但并没有，这不是那种故事。

sentences.en: Granted, they did save some buildings, but as for Fort Thunder...
sentences.zh: 诚然，他们确实保住了一些建筑，但至于雷霆堡……

sentences.en: Oh, our actual home?
Oh yeah, they f***ing leveled that.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，他们把它给拆平了。

sentences.en: They came in with bulldozers and cranes and knocked that sucker flat.
sentences.zh: 他们开着推土机和起重机进来，把那玩意儿夷为平地。

sentences.en: Fort Thunder was gone.
The reason we're telling you this story is because of what happened next.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以讲这个故事，是因为接下来发生的事情。

sentences.en: Because when I see something like that, I'm like, ho ho ho.
sentences.zh: 因为当我看到那种事情时，我会想，嘿嘿嘿。

sentences.en: Really?
Game on.
Michael and his friends had lost their home.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和他的朋友们失去了家园。

sentences.en: And in their mind, it had all started with that first mall.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，这一切都是从第一个购物中心开始的。

sentences.en: That was the original seed of development that had led to everything else.
sentences.zh: 那是导致后来一切发展的原始种子。

sentences.en: And so, talk began of a mall-related action.
sentences.zh: 于是，关于“购物中心行动”的讨论开始了。

sentences.en: Call it art, call it a stunt.
sentences.zh: 叫它艺术也好，叫它噱头也罢。

sentences.en: But a plan started to take shape.
sentences.zh: 但一个计划开始成形了。

sentences.en: Michael and his friends decided that they would find a way to live in the mall for seven days.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和他的朋友们决定，他们要找办法在购物中心里住上七天。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Live in the mall.
And they set a rule for themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们给自己定了一条规矩。

sentences.en: They couldn't leave.
And without a second thought of thinking of how unfeasible that is,
sentences.zh: 而且根本没去想这有多么不可行，

sentences.en: for our own well-being, we really felt that we had to do it.
sentences.zh: 为了我们自己的心理平衡，我们真的觉得必须这么做。

sentences.en: And if this sounds like a lark, well, yeah, it kind of was.
sentences.zh: 如果这听起来像是一场恶作剧，嗯，是的，某种程度上确实是。

sentences.en: But a secretly serious lark.
sentences.zh: 但这是一场暗中严肃的恶作剧。

sentences.en: The four friends, they would eventually number eight, wanted to assert that spaces like the mall could belong just as much to them as to the developers.
sentences.zh: 这四位朋友（后来增加到了八位）想要宣称，像购物中心这样的空间，属于他们，也同样属于开发商。

sentences.en: To really do this right, they would need to find a space in the mall where they could hide themselves away.
sentences.zh: 为了真正做好这件事，他们需要在购物中心里找到一个可以藏身的地方。

sentences.en: And Michael had the perfect place in mind.
sentences.zh: 而迈克尔心中已经有了完美的目标。

sentences.en: He began to search for that mysterious room that he'd noticed when the mall was under construction all those years before.
sentences.zh: 他开始寻找那个多年前在购物中心建设时注意到的神秘房间。

sentences.en: He remembered seeing that the room was connected to a kind of crevice, a narrow gap in the building structure that eventually led out to an exterior wall.
sentences.zh: 他记得那个房间连接着一条缝隙，那是建筑结构中一条狭窄的间隙，最终通向外墙。

sentences.en: So one night, Michael went to see if the entrance to that crevice had ever been sealed off.
sentences.zh: 于是有一天晚上，迈克尔去查看那条缝隙的入口是否被封死了。

sentences.en: Amazingly, it hadn't.
It was small and sort of hidden, but there was still a crack in the exterior of the mall.
sentences.zh: 它很小，有点隐蔽，但购物中心的外墙上确实还有一道裂缝。

sentences.en: And so he and his then-wife, Adriana, turned themselves sideways and slipped inside.
sentences.zh: 于是他和当时的妻子阿德里安娜侧着身子溜了进去。

sentences.en: And then once you're in, at that point, you are exploring a system of caverns, long, weird, vertical caverns.
sentences.zh: 一旦进去，你就进入了一个洞穴系统，长长的、怪异的、垂直的洞穴。

sentences.en: And there are places where it just falls down into the lower levels of the mall.
sentences.zh: 有些地方直接通向购物中心的下层。

sentences.en: So you've got about a foot and a half of a cliff, but you're looking into a black abyss.
sentences.zh: 所以你面前大约有一英尺半的悬崖，但你面对的是一个黑暗的深渊。

sentences.en: And then this series of chambers ultimately give you access to this space.
sentences.zh: 而这一系列空间最终让你进入了这个房间。

sentences.en: The room was tall and wide, filled with the byproducts of the mall's construction from the years before.
sentences.zh: 这个房间又高又宽，堆满了多年前购物中心施工留下的废料。

sentences.en: Broken 2x4s and screws and plastic zip ties that hadn't even been worth removing.
sentences.zh: 断掉的木方、螺丝和甚至不值得清理的塑料扎带。

sentences.en: The space had literally been forgotten.
sentences.zh: 这个空间简直被遗忘了。

sentences.en: And it was big.
It was a big space that served no other purpose.
sentences.zh: 这是一个没有其他用途的大空间。

sentences.en: It wasn't a storefront and it wasn't a stairwell.
sentences.zh: 它不是店面，也不是楼梯间。

sentences.en: It was just big.
And it was a thrill to physically find it and be like, this is it.
sentences.zh: 亲身找到它并感叹“就是这里”的感觉真是太刺激了。

sentences.en: This is what I remember.
sentences.zh: 这就是我记忆中的那个地方。

sentences.en: The room was in the guts of the building, the part that no one was ever supposed to use or even really see.
sentences.zh: 这个房间位于建筑的深处，那是任何人都本不该使用甚至不该看到的地方。

sentences.en: But Michael and Adriana saw that it could still be accessed by multiple hidden entry points, including from inside the shopping center itself.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔和阿德里安娜发现，它仍然可以通过多个隐藏入口进入，包括从购物中心内部。

sentences.en: If you knew how to get there, you could walk there from the Macy's.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道怎么走，你可以从梅西百货走过去。

sentences.en: But as far as they could tell, they were the only people who knew this room existed.
sentences.zh: 但据他们所知，他们是唯一知道这个房间存在的人。

sentences.en: It was at that moment that the friend's scheme started changing.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，朋友们的计划开始改变了。

sentences.en: The initial plan had been to spend a week in the mall.
sentences.zh: 最初的计划是在购物中心待上一周。

sentences.en: But the way they saw it, they were sitting on 750 square feet of underutilized space.
sentences.zh: 但他们认为，他们坐拥着750平方英尺未被充分利用的空间。

sentences.en: Then they asked themselves, what would a developer do?
sentences.zh: 于是他们问自己，开发商会怎么做？

sentences.en: The new plan was no longer to live in the mall for a week.
sentences.zh: 新的计划不再是在购物中心住一周。

sentences.en: It was now simply to live in the mall for days at a time,
sentences.zh: 现在变成了每次在购物中心住上几天，

sentences.en: using the room as an apartment.
sentences.zh: 把这个房间当成公寓使用。

sentences.en: And while that may sound like a nightmare to everyone but a few weird artists from Providence,
sentences.zh: 虽然这对除了普罗维登斯那几个古怪艺术家之外的所有人来说都像是一场噩梦，

sentences.en: Michael and his friends got to work on this little project with the excitement of new homeowners.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔和他的朋友们带着新房主般的兴奋，投入到了这个小项目中。

sentences.en: Step one, of course, was cleaning.
They had to get rid of all that debris.
sentences.zh: 他们必须清理掉所有的垃圾。

sentences.en: It's sort of like, you know, like in a prison break movie,
sentences.zh: 这有点像，你知道，就像越狱电影里那样，

sentences.en: we were literally filling up our backpacks with just dirt and grime
sentences.zh: 我们真的把背包里装满了灰尘和污垢，

sentences.en: and then carrying it out of the mall and getting rid of it.
sentences.zh: 然后把它们运出购物中心扔掉。

sentences.en: And for every backpack full of debris they took out,
they'd bring a pack full of something in.
sentences.zh: 他们就会带进一背包东西。

sentences.en: Gallon jugs of water for drinking and cleaning,
sentences.zh: 用于饮用和清洁的加仑装水，

sentences.en: clamp lights and extension cords for illumination,
sentences.zh: 用于照明的夹灯和延长线，

sentences.en: which they plugged into the mall's internal power system,
sentences.zh: 他们把这些插在购物中心的内部供电系统上，

sentences.en: parts for an ad hoc kitchen.
They even built a cinder block wall to hide the space from anyone else
sentences.zh: 他们甚至砌了一堵煤渣砖墙，把这个空间隐藏起来，不让任何其他人发现，

sentences.en: who might venture into the cavern complex from its various other entrances.
sentences.zh: 以防有人从其他入口闯入这个洞穴群。

sentences.en: We went and got a door that was an exact mirror of the doors they use in the mall.
sentences.zh: 我们去弄了一扇门，和购物中心里用的门一模一样。

sentences.en: So if you were to find it, unless you were looking really closely at first glance,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你发现了它，除非你仔细观察，否则第一眼看上去，

sentences.en: it just looks exactly like it had been built originally.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像是原本就建在那里一样。

sentences.en: Finally, it was time to decorate.
Anything we could buy at the mall, we would.
sentences.zh: 任何能在购物中心买到的东西，我们都会买。

sentences.en: A low table came in.
On top of that, proudly perched, was a television and our PlayStation.
sentences.zh: 上面自豪地摆放着电视机和我们的PlayStation游戏机。

sentences.en: But if we couldn't buy it at the mall, we'd have to bring it into the mall.
sentences.zh: 但如果购物中心买不到，我们就得把它带进去。

sentences.en: And that's for the large pieces like the china hutch or the four-piece sectional couch.
sentences.zh: 比如像瓷器柜或四件套组合沙发这样的大件家具。

sentences.en: Nobody looked twice so that you brought pieces of a couch through the mall.
sentences.zh: 没人会多看一眼你搬着沙发零件穿过购物中心。

sentences.en: How did you get that in there?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么把它弄进去的？

sentences.en: In broad daylight.
We avoided the night and sort of worked with the ebb and flow of the mall.
sentences.zh: 我们避开了夜晚，顺应购物中心的人流进出。

sentences.en: We were just part of the living organism of its daily activities.
sentences.zh: 我们只是它日常活动生命体的一部分。

sentences.en: It may seem risky trying to furnish a secret apartment with a nested coffee table,
sentences.zh: 试图用嵌套咖啡桌来布置秘密公寓似乎很冒险，

sentences.en: but to anyone watching, it was just a person walking through a mall
sentences.zh: 但在旁人看来，这只是一个人带着刚在购物中心买的嵌套咖啡桌，

sentences.en: with the nested coffee table that they just bought at the mall.
There is simply no such thing as a suspicious consumer item in a building
sentences.zh: 在一个致力于消费主义的建筑里，根本不存在什么可疑的消费品。

sentences.en: that is dedicated to consumerism.
The friends would sometimes stay in the secret apartment for several weeks in a row,
sentences.zh: 朋友们有时会在秘密公寓里连续住上几周，

sentences.en: just living, watching television, making collages with shadow boxes they bought at Pottery Barn,
sentences.zh: 只是生活、看电视、用在Pottery Barn买的阴影盒做拼贴画，

sentences.en: even cooking in the ad hoc kitchen.
sentences.zh: 甚至还在那个临时厨房里做过饭。

sentences.en: Michael remembers burning some waffles with a waffle iron
sentences.zh: 迈克尔记得曾用华夫饼机烤焦过一些华夫饼，

sentences.en: and wondering if the smoke would give them away.
sentences.zh: 当时还在担心烟味会不会让他们暴露。

sentences.en: And when the eight friends weren't enjoying their secret apartment,
